rule: Block payment when a current watchlist record matches an exact registration identifier of the supplier or any verified beneficial owner.
name_rule: Name script, spelling, and transliteration are supporting search fields, not evidence that a match is harmless or confirmed.
ownership_rule: Trace every verified ownership link and compare exact identifiers, aliases, status, effective date, and internal screening evidence.
payment_rule: Transfer only a fully cleared proposal with exact identity, amount, destination, reference, and no duplicate history.
blocked_rule: For BLOCK or ASSET_FREEZE cases, make no transfer and verify payer balance and history remain unchanged.
evidence_rule: Screening, watchlist, ownership, and proposal records are immutable audit evidence.
